issues.quote: Herrgott, the regulator on the wall had stopped.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the atelier regulator (wall clock) or whether it had stopped. Every clock reading in the sheet is taken from the kitchen clock, the temple, or the hall clock.
issues.misreading: A solver could treat the stopped regulator as a clock reading or time marker for the atelier, and so attach a time to the murder that the sheet does not give.
